content.rendered:
A public meeting of the Budget Committee of the Sherwood School District, Washington County, State of Oregon, to discuss the budget for the fiscal year July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026, will be held at the District Office Boardroom, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140. The meeting will take place on Monday, May 19, 2025, at 5:00 p.m.

This will be an in-person public meeting. To view a live stream of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3

The purpose of the meeting is to receive the budget message and to receive comments from the public on the budget. This is a public meeting where deliberation of the Budget Committee will take place. Any person may appear at the meeting and may ask questions or make public comments about the proposed budget with the Budget Committee.

A copy of the budget document may be inspected or obtained on or after Tuesday, May 13 at Sherwood School District Office, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140 between the hours of 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM. A copy of the budget document will also be available on the district’s website, www.sherwood.k12.or.us, on or after Tuesday, May 13.

If the Budget Committee meeting is continued to a future date, the following days and times have been tentatively reserved:

Wednesday, May 21, 2025 – 5:00 p.m.
Tuesday, May 27, 2025 – 5:00 p.m.
